title: Israel Worships a Golden Calf
lines: Moses was the leader God chose to lead his chosen people, the Israelites, out of Egypt.
摩西是神揀選的領袖，要帶領祂的選民以色列人出埃及。
After God showed his miraculous power in Egypt, he led the Israelites through the Red Sea and towards the promised land.
神在埃及彰顯祂奇妙的大能之後，就帶領以色列人過紅海，往應許之地去。
They followed God, who showed himself as a cloud by day and a fire by night.
他們跟隨神，神白天在雲柱中、夜間在火柱中向他們顯現。
A few months after the Israelites left Egypt, they came to the desert of Sinai and camped there in front of the mountain.
以色列人出埃及幾個月後，來到西奈的曠野，就在山前安營。
God gave the Israelites a special set of rules called the Ten Commandments.
神賜給以色列人一套特別的規條，稱為十誡。
Moses climbed up to the mountain to hear from God, but the people were afraid.
摩西爬上山去聽神的話，但百姓都很害怕。
While the people remained a long way off, the Lord spoke to Moses and gave him many more commandments and instructions for the people of Israel to follow.
百姓遠遠地站著，耶和華對摩西說話，又給他許多誡命和指示，要以色列人遵行。
Then God wrote the commandments on two stone tablets and gave them to Moses.
神把誡命寫在兩塊石版上，交給摩西。
God told Moses that he must teach the people to obey the rules and do all that God had commanded.
神告訴摩西，他必須教導百姓遵守這些規條，照神所吩咐的一切去行。
When the Israelites followed God's commandments, they would show the world they lived differently than all the others and that they were God's chosen people.
以色列人遵行神的誡命時，就會讓世人看見，他們的生活與眾不同，他們是神的選民。
The people saw that Moses took a long time to come down from the mountain and they didn't know what happened to him.
百姓見摩西遲遲不下山，不知道他遭遇了甚麼事。
So they gathered around Aaron and asked him to make a god that could lead them.
於是他們聚集到亞倫那裡，要他造一個能帶領他們的神。
Aaron told them to give him their gold and he made it into a metal statue of a god that looked like a calf.
亞倫叫他們把金子交給他，他把金子鑄成一尊像牛犢的神像。
Then the people said, "Israel, here is your god who brought you up out of Egypt."
百姓就說：「以色列啊，這是領你出埃及的神！」
Aaron built an altar in front of the calf and declared the next day a feast day.
亞倫在牛犢面前築壇，宣告明天要向耶和華守節。
They sacrificed to the calf, celebrated, and danced wildly in front of their god.
他們向牛犢獻祭、慶祝，在他們的神面前狂歡跳舞。
The Lord spoke to Moses and told him to go down the mountain because of what the people were doing.
耶和華對摩西說話，因百姓所做的事，吩咐他下山去。
God told Moses that he would destroy the Israelites, but make a new nation out of Moses' family.
神告訴摩西，祂要滅絕以色列人，卻要使摩西的家族成為大國。
But Moses asked the Lord to have mercy on his people.
但摩西求耶和華憐憫祂的百姓。
Then the Lord took pity on his people.
於是耶和華憐恤祂的百姓。
He didn't destroy them as he said he would.
祂沒有照所說的毀滅他們。
Moses turned and went down the mountain.
He had two tablets that God had written in his hands.
他手裡拿著神親手寫的兩塊法版。
Joshua, Moses' assistant, heard the noise of the people shouting.
摩西的助手約書亞聽見百姓呼喊的聲音。
So he said to Moses, "It sounds like war in the camp."
他就對摩西說：「營裡有爭戰的聲音。」
But Moses said it was the sound of singing.
摩西卻說，那是唱歌的聲音。
As Moses approached the camp, he saw the calf and what the people were doing.
摩西走近營地，看見牛犢，也看見百姓所做的事。
He threw the tablets out of his hands and they broke into pieces at the foot of the mountain.
他把兩塊法版從手裡扔下，在山腳下摔碎了。
He took the calf the people had made.
他把百姓所造的牛犢拿來，
He burned it in the fire.
Then he ground it into powder.
He scattered it on the water and he made the Israelites drink it.
撒在水面上，叫以色列人喝。
Moses asked Aaron why he would let the people do this.
摩西問亞倫，為甚麼讓百姓這樣做。
Aaron said it was the people's fault and that when he threw the gold into the fire, it came out as a calf.
亞倫說這是百姓的錯，又說他把金子扔進火裡，這牛犢就出來了。
Moses said, "Anyone on the Lord's side, come to me."
摩西說：「凡屬耶和華的，都要到我這裡來！」
利未人都聚集到他那裡。
Moses had the Levites punish the people for their sin.
摩西叫利未人為百姓的罪懲罰他們。
And the next day, Moses turned the people over to the Lord, but asked that he forgive their sin.
第二天，摩西把百姓交在耶和華面前，求祂赦免他們的罪。
The Lord sent a plague because of what the people did with the calf, but he didn't destroy the nation of Israel, even though they had turned away from him.
耶和華因百姓造牛犢的事降下災殃，但祂沒有毀滅以色列，雖然他們背離了祂。
Later, God had Moses make two new stone tablets, and God wrote on them the same words that were on the first tablets.
後來，神叫摩西另鑿兩塊石版，神在上面寫了與先前那兩塊相同的字。
God continued to speak with Moses and guide him as he led the Israelites.
神繼續與摩西說話，在他帶領以色列人的路上引導他。
